description: Golden test vectors for the sealed_trace envelope format (v2).
TEST ONLY: the private key below is published on purpose and protects nothing.
RSA-OAEP is randomized, so wrappedKey differs on every encryption. Verify envelopes by DECRYPTING them, not by comparing wrappedKey bytes.
aesGcmCases are fully deterministic: the same key, iv and plaintext must give exactly the listed ciphertext and tag.
envelopes hold complete wire envelopes (the shape POSTed to /api/v1/ingest/logs), the AES key they must unwrap to, and the plaintext they must decrypt to.

specification.plaintext: UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON array of LogEvent objects (no spaces, keys in the order id, seq, ts, level, tag, message, error, stackTrace, metadata, sessionId, userId, ctx; non-ASCII characters are not escaped), followed by ASCII spaces (0x20) up to the Padme length of its size (see "padding"). Trailing whitespace is valid JSON, so parse the decrypted bytes as they are or strip the spaces first.
specification.padding: paddedLength is 256 if L <= 256; otherwise, with E = floor(log2 L), S = floor(log2 E) + 1, mask = 2^(E - S) - 1, paddedLength = (L + mask) & ~mask (Nikitin et al., PETS 2019). L is the JSON length in bytes. Each case lists plaintextJson (unpadded) and paddedLength.
specification.aes: AES-256-GCM, 32-byte random key, 12-byte random IV, 16-byte tag stored separately from the ciphertext. Envelopes authenticate the additional data described under "aad"; aesGcmCases use none.
specification.aad: UTF-8 bytes of six lines joined by a single LF (0x0A), no trailing LF: "sealed_trace.envelope.v2", then alg, projectId, batchId, createdAt and eventCount exactly as they appear in the wire JSON (eventCount in decimal). Rebuild it from the received fields; any change to them makes the tag check fail. v1 envelopes had no AAD.
specification.rsa: RSA-OAEP over the 32-byte AES key: 2048-bit key, SHA-256 label hash, MGF1 with SHA-256, empty label. wrappedKey is 256 bytes.

openssl: Save the private key as test_private.pem and one wrappedKey as wrapped.b64, then:
openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey test_private.pem -in wrapped.bin -pkeyopt rsa_padding_mode:oaep -pkeyopt rsa_oaep_md:sha256 -pkeyopt rsa_mgf1_md:sha256 | base64
The output must equal the case's aesKeyBase64.
